items.title: Yattendon Group Pension Scheme completes £64m buy-in with Royal London
items.summary: The Yattendon Group Pension Scheme has finalised a £64m full buy-in with Royal London, securing the benefits of 871 members.

items.title: QBE warns UK businesses underestimate cyber risks from executive impersonation attacks
items.summary: Research published by QBE indicates that while UK business leaders recognise finance and IT as primary targets, they may under-prioritise board-level exposures.

items.title: Nearly half of European high-net-worth investors turn to alternatives for tech exposure
items.summary: A Goldman Sachs survey reported by Investment Week reveals that a significant share of wealthy European and UK investors view private markets as the preferred route into technology and AI.

items.title: Lloyd's appoints former PwC insurance head to Council as WTW names French aviation lead
items.summary: Lloyd's has named Stephen O'Hearn as an independent nominated non-executive member of its Council, while WTW has appointed Jean-Pascal Mouchette to lead its aviation business in France.

items.title: Dynagas seeks replacement marine insurance for two Russian-chartered LNG carriers ahead of UK ban
items.summary: Dynagas LNG Partners is scrambling to secure protection and indemnity and hull cover for two ice-class LNG carriers before UK sanctions bar British insurers from Russian LNG voyages.

items.title: Over one third of pension transfers to potential green list schemes trigger scam warnings
items.summary: XPS Group analysis shows that over a third of pension transfers directed towards potentially reputable schemes raised scam warning flags.
